scientific_limits: Only a development experiment is ready; this review does not pre-approve its unknown results.
Fixed bandwidth/block, S12,T128 and square-root finite-calendar bias have no general finite-sample theorem.
The bounded cases omit some regimes such as calendar-only/heavy-tail stress and candidate-suboptimal ties; no universal strong-control claim follows.
Passing component FWER tolerance screens would not by itself certify coverage, complete three-method power, a viable candidate or market R3.
